svg.title: Four Checks Before Irreversible Option Spend
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-rights-power-and-land; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before Irreversible Option Spend; subtitle: Any failed check redirects the site to remediation or rejection.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Four ordered decision nodes, each with a pass and stop outcome described in its detail. Federal and California citations identify concrete requirements; determine the actual state, local jurisdiction, utility tariff, and project-specific applicability for every parcel.; caption: Principal rights, utility evidence, land-use feasibility, and bounded downside must agree before pricing the assignment.; stages: label: Verify transaction role and rights; value: Proceed only with valid rights and role analysis; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Check California Business and Professions Code sections 10130 and 10131 where applicable, or the site state's corresponding statutes. Pass with a valid principal option interest and supported licensure analysis, or licensed broker participation; stop if unlicensed activity or transfer defects remain.; label: Validate utility service evidence; value: Proceed only with documented power and upgrade exposure; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply the relevant tariff and, where applicable, 18 CFR 35.28. Separate load-service requests from storage interconnection requests. Pass when documented MW, restudy exposure, upgrade responsibility, and timing support the deal; stop when the thesis depends only on line proximity or an unstudied filing.; label: Resolve land-use and environmental barriers; value: Proceed only with a viable parcel-specific entitlement path; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Check adopted zoning text, active municipal moratoriums, fire requirements, title, and mineral rights. Evaluate Clean Water Act section 404 under 33 U.S.C. 1344 for covered discharges. Pass with a documented path and priced conditions; stop for prohibited use or an unresolved fatal site constraint.; label: Bound expiration and delivery losses; value: Proceed only when downside fits available committed cash; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Stress delayed energization, network-upgrade restudy, option expiration, buyer withdrawal, and extension pricing. Confirm AI fiber and water requirements separately from BESS needs. Pass within written spending limits; renegotiate or reject uncapped upgrade exposure and unaffordable option-fee burn.

text.title: Four Checks Before Irreversible Option Spend
text.tspan: Four Checks Before Irreversible Option Spend

circle.title: label: Verify transaction role and rights; value: Proceed only with valid rights and role analysis; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Check California Business and Professions Code sections 10130 and 10131 where applicable, or the site state's corresponding statutes. Pass with a valid principal option interest and supported licensure analysis, or licensed broker participation; stop if unlicensed activity or transfer defects remain.

text.title: Check California Business and Professions Code sections 10130 and 10131 where applicable, or the site state's corresponding statutes. Pass with a valid principal option interest and supported licensure analysis, or licensed broker participation; stop if unlicensed activity or transfer defects remain.

circle.title: label: Validate utility service evidence; value: Proceed only with documented power and upgrade exposure; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply the relevant tariff and, where applicable, 18 CFR 35.28. Separate load-service requests from storage interconnection requests. Pass when documented MW, restudy exposure, upgrade responsibility, and timing support the deal; stop when the thesis depends only on line proximity or an unstudied filing.

text.title: Apply the relevant tariff and, where applicable, 18 CFR 35.28. Separate load-service requests from storage interconnection requests. Pass when documented MW, restudy exposure, upgrade responsibility, and timing support the deal; stop when the thesis depends only on line proximity or an unstudied filing.

circle.title: label: Resolve land-use and environmental barriers; value: Proceed only with a viable parcel-specific entitlement path; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Check adopted zoning text, active municipal moratoriums, fire requirements, title, and mineral rights. Evaluate Clean Water Act section 404 under 33 U.S.C. 1344 for covered discharges. Pass with a documented path and priced conditions; stop for prohibited use or an unresolved fatal site constraint.

text.title: Check adopted zoning text, active municipal moratoriums, fire requirements, title, and mineral rights. Evaluate Clean Water Act section 404 under 33 U.S.C. 1344 for covered discharges. Pass with a documented path and priced conditions; stop for prohibited use or an unresolved fatal site constraint.

circle.title: label: Bound expiration and delivery losses; value: Proceed only when downside fits available committed cash; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Stress delayed energization, network-upgrade restudy, option expiration, buyer withdrawal, and extension pricing. Confirm AI fiber and water requirements separately from BESS needs. Pass within written spending limits; renegotiate or reject uncapped upgrade exposure and unaffordable option-fee burn.

text.title: Stress delayed energization, network-upgrade restudy, option expiration, buyer withdrawal, and extension pricing. Confirm AI fiber and water requirements separately from BESS needs. Pass within written spending limits; renegotiate or reject uncapped upgrade exposure and unaffordable option-fee burn.

Assumptions: Four ordered decision nodes, each with a pass and stop outcome described in its detail. Federal and California citations identify concrete requirements; determine the actual state, local jurisdiction, utility tariff, and project-specific applicability for every parcel.
